通行碼不對，再仔細看一次日誌。: That access code is wrong. Read the log again carefully.
大小不對，注意要看 report.dat 那一行的第 5 欄。: Wrong size. Look at column 5 of the report.dat line.
不是這個值，看看第一行。: That's not the value. Look at the first line.
校驗碼不對，要看最後一行。: Wrong checksum. Look at the last line.
不對，再查一次 man ls 的 sort 相關選項。: Wrong. Check the sort-related options in man ls again.
路徑不對，直接用 which 查。: Wrong path. Just use which to find it.
格式是 使用者@主機，兩個值都要查。: The format is user@host. You need to look up both values.
那是誘餌！回頭看線索指向哪一層。: That's a decoy! Go back and see which level the clue points to.
不對，用 file 看它怎麼說。: Wrong. Use file to see what it says.
不是最大的那個，比較一下 du -sh 的數字。: That's not the biggest one. Compare the du -sh numbers.
再往下看，要最深的一層。: Keep going down: you want the deepest level.
還有檔案沒歸位。: Some files are still out of place.
路徑不對，用 find 的輸出直接複製。: Wrong path. Copy it straight from the find output.
數量不對。注意：README.md 的名字不是單純的 readme。: Wrong count. Note that README.md isn't simply named readme.
數量不對，記得只算目錄。: Wrong count. Remember to count directories only.
不是這個，確認單位是 +1M。: That's not it. Make sure the unit is +1M.
數量不對，註解行要排除。: Wrong count. Exclude the comment lines.
原因不對，要看 CRITICAL 的下一行。: Wrong cause. Look at the line after CRITICAL.
金鑰不對，要完整的那一串。: Wrong key. You need the complete string.
金鑰已回報，但含金鑰的檔案還沒刪除。: The key is reported, but the file containing it hasn't been deleted yet.
不是出現最多的那個。: That's not the most frequent one.
名字不對，分數在第 3 欄。: Wrong name. The score is in column 3.
總和不對，要把第 3 欄全部加起來。: Wrong total. Add up all of column 3.
不對，看 > 開頭那行（新檔案）。: Wrong. Look at the line starting with > (the new file).
不是那位，確認 role 是 pilot。: That's not the one. Make sure the role is pilot.
數量不對，記得去重。: Wrong count. Remember to remove duplicates.
三個值要用空白隔開，順序是：IP 5xx數量 小時。: Separate the three values with spaces, in this order: IP 5xx-count hour.
不對，用 id 看 uid=。: Wrong. Use id and look at uid=.
不是這個，找最後一組權限有 w 的。: That's not it. Find the one whose last permission group has w.
不對，看最後一欄。: Wrong. Look at the last column.
不對，先設定 umask 077 再建立新檔案。: Wrong. Set umask 077 first, then create a new file.
目錄的群組要是 dev。: The directory's group must be dev.
權限要同時有 setgid 與 sticky，且其他人零權限：3770。: The permissions need both setgid and sticky, and zero for others: 3770.
alice 應該能在目錄裡建立檔案。: alice should be able to create files in the directory.
新檔案應該繼承 dev 群組。: New files should inherit the dev group.
bob 應該能建立檔案。: bob should be able to create files.
bob 不應該能刪除 alice 的檔案。: bob should not be able to delete alice's files.
carol 不屬於 dev，不應該能進入。: carol is not in dev and should not be able to enter.
PID 不對，再用 ps 或 pgrep 查一次。: Wrong PID. Check again with ps or pgrep.
不對，看 ps aux 的第一欄。: Wrong. Look at the first column of ps aux.
不是最吃 CPU 的那個。: That's not the biggest CPU consumer.
數字不對，要看 Mem: 那行的 total。: Wrong number. Look at the total on the Mem: line.
PID 不對，用 lsof 指定檔案路徑查查看。: Wrong PID. Query with lsof using the file path.
PID 不對，看 ss 輸出裡 pid= 後面的數字。: Wrong PID. Look at the number after pid= in the ss output.
不對，timeout 中止指令時的結束碼是特定的值。: Wrong. timeout uses a specific exit code when it stops a command.
starlink-daemon 被誤殺了！用 restart 重來。: starlink-daemon was killed by mistake! Use restart to start over.
數量不對，目錄也算一個項目。: Wrong count. A directory also counts as an item.
不對，只要冒號前面的套件名。: Wrong. You only want the package name before the colon.
不對，注意分、時、星期三個欄位。: Wrong. Pay attention to the three fields: minute, hour, weekday.
代碼不對，找標示 ERROR 的那一行。: Wrong code. Find the line marked ERROR.
不對，看 df -T 輸出的 Type 欄。: Wrong. Look at the Type column of df -T.
備份腳本還不能執行。: The backup script isn't executable yet.
備份目錄 ~/backups 還不存在。: The backup directory ~/backups doesn't exist yet.
還沒有產生備份檔。實際執行一次腳本看看。: No backup file yet. Run the script once for real.
還沒有排進 cron（每天 2:00）。: It hasn't been scheduled in cron yet (daily at 2:00).
第一行要有 shebang，例如 #!/bin/bash。: The first line needs a shebang, e.g. #!/bin/bash.
有參數時要印出 Hello, 名字!: With an argument it should print Hello, name!
三個動作的輸出不對。: The output of the three actions is wrong.
輸出格式要是 max=9 min=2。: The output format must be max=9 min=2.
請用函式實作。: Please implement it with a function.
來源存在時要複製並印 copied。: When the source exists, copy it and print copied.
只有 -n 時印 Hello, NAME。: With only -n it should print Hello, NAME.
加 -v 時要多印 (verbose mode)。: With -v it should also print (verbose mode).
最後要印 all done。: It should print all done at the end.
太慢了，三個工作要平行執行。: Too slow. The three jobs must run in parallel.
功能不能變：要印出每個 .txt 檔名（含空白的檔名也要完整）。: The behavior must not change: print every .txt file name (including names with spaces, in full).
沒有參數時要印用法並以 1 結束。: With no arguments it should print usage and exit with 1.
SRC 不是目錄：印 error: SRC not found，結束碼 2。: If SRC is not a directory: print error: SRC not found, exit code 2.
成功時印 OK 檔案路徑，結束碼 0。實際：{}: On success print OK and the file path, exit code 0. Actual: {}
-v 時最前面多印 Backing up SRC -> DEST。: With -v, print Backing up SRC -> DEST first.
位址不對，找 inet 那一行，不含斜線和後面的數字。: Wrong address. Find the inet line, without the slash and the number after it.
不對，看結尾那行統計裡的 received。: Wrong. Look at received in the summary line at the end.
呼號不對，看 <h1> 裡的文字。: Wrong call sign. Look at the text inside <h1>.
不對，逐一檢查三個路徑的狀態碼。: Wrong. Check the status code of each of the three paths.
內容不對。沒帶對標頭會得到 unauthorized。: Wrong content. Without the right header you get unauthorized.
封包檔裡沒有足夠的 8080 埠封包（要先開始抓，再發請求）。: Not enough port 8080 packets in the capture (start capturing first, then send the request).
9401 本來就該被封鎖，別刪錯了。用 restart 重來。: 9401 was supposed to stay blocked. Don't delete the wrong one. Use restart to start over.
要用 ed25519 演算法。: You must use the ed25519 algorithm.
不對，只要前 8 個字元。: Wrong. You only need the first 8 characters.
不對，數標題以外的行數。: Wrong. Count the lines other than the header.
第一層：名稱 portal 還無法解析。: Layer 1: the name portal still can't be resolved.
第二層：沒有服務在聽 8088。: Layer 2: no service is listening on 8088.
第三層：服務在聽，但防火牆還擋著 8088。: Layer 3: the service is listening, but the firewall is still blocking 8088.
再想想：quit 加上強制的驚嘆號。: Think again: quit plus a forceful exclamation mark.
不對，用 git status 找標示 modified 的那個。: Wrong. Use git status and find the one marked modified.
雜湊不對，取 --oneline 前面的 7 碼。: Wrong hash. Take the first 7 characters from --oneline.
目前要在 feature-x 分支上。: You need to be on the feature-x branch now.
合併還沒完成，記得 git add 與 git commit。: The merge isn't finished. Remember git add and git commit.
還沒有合併提交。先 git merge feature。: There's no merge commit yet. Run git merge feature first.
Makefile 裡要有 result.txt: input.txt 這條規則。: The Makefile needs the rule result.txt: input.txt.
還沒有 git 版本庫 ~/mission。: The git repository ~/mission doesn't exist yet.
需要 README.md 與 Makefile。: README.md and a Makefile are required.
至少要有兩筆提交。: At least two commits are required.
還沒有 release 分支。: The release branch doesn't exist yet.
還沒有 v1.0 標籤。: The v1.0 tag doesn't exist yet.
make test 要印出 tests passed。: make test must print tests passed.
路徑不對，找 ENOENT 且在 /etc/station/ 底下的那一行。: Wrong path. Find the line with ENOENT under /etc/station/.
不對，只要函式庫檔名（箭頭左邊那個）。: Wrong. You only want the library file name (the one left of the arrow).
不對，要前 4 個位元組，共 8 個十六進位字元。: Wrong. You need the first 4 bytes, 8 hex characters in total.
數字不對，只要 MemTotal 那一行的數值。: Wrong number. You only want the value on the MemTotal line.
數量不對，兩份都要有才算。: Wrong count. It only counts if both are present.
完成時間差太大，要平行跑（-P 8）。用 /restart 重來。: Finished too slowly. Run in parallel (-P 8). Use /restart to start over.
檔案數量不對，別刪東西。: Wrong file count. Don't delete anything.
權限太寬了，只能允許 apt。: The permissions are too broad. Only apt may be allowed.
三個安全設定都要正確。: All three security settings must be correct.
其餘設定要保留（Port 22）。: The other settings must be kept (Port 22).
sshd -t 檢查沒過。: The sshd -t check did not pass.
不是最多人用的那個。: That's not the most used one.
不是最慢的那個，三支都用 time 量一次。: That's not the slowest. Measure all three with time.
數字不對，注意要當 4 位元組無號整數 (u4)。: Wrong number. Treat it as a 4-byte unsigned integer (u4).
① audit.log 還是太大（要清空但保留檔案）。: ① audit.log is still too big (empty it but keep the file).
② cpu-hog 還在吃 CPU。: ② cpu-hog is still eating CPU.
③ gateway.service 還沒有成功執行。: ③ gateway.service is not running successfully yet.
④ /srv/shared 要是群組 ops、權限 2775。: ④ /srv/shared must be group ops with permissions 2775.
⑤ 防火牆還擋著 9700。: ⑤ The firewall is still blocking 9700.
句子不對。確認 11 個單字都在，而且依檔案編號排序。: Wrong sentence. Make sure all 11 words are there, in file number order.
